principle: Singular editable Toon RTS tree. Each race folder is the unit of truth: infantry (modular foot), cavalry (mount+rider), siege (catapult/boltthrower), optional equipment glTFs, Bip001 anim clips, PNG atlases. Manifest is the race catalog; .bin is only the glTF buffer.

howBinsWork.rule: NEVER load .bin alone. Load the .gltf; GLTFLoader fetches buffers[].uri.

infantry.meshEquip: visibility on skinned Units_* variants in one glTF

cavalry.meshEquip: separate mount material (Horse/Wolf); do not tint mount as body

siege.meshEquip: engine mesh only; never hero-fit to 1.8 m

equipment.note: Prefer kit-embedded mesh visibility for body armor; equipment/ is extras

loadContract.infantry: GLTFLoader(baseUrl + character.infantry.gltf); bind textures.defaultBody; equip via mesh visibility
loadContract.cavalry: load cavalry.gltf; apply textures.mount to mount materials only; SI = heightMeters.cavalry
loadContract.siege: load character.siege[n].gltf; play animations where class matches catapult_* or boltthrower_*
never: hero-fit siege or cavalry to 1.8 m
Mixamo retarget onto Bip001 multipack infantry

fleetCdnBridge.note: Production CDN still hosts monolithic WK_Characters.fbx/glb for paperdoll. This tree is the editable split Toon RTS SSOT for customizer + mounts + siege. Bake/publish should promote from here.
